description: Exact match of an EVM wallet address against the digital currency address identifiers on the official US Treasury OFAC SDN List (validated snapshot, refreshed hourly). Returns signed listed / not_listed, the SDN entry, dataset provenance and limits. SDN only: not EU/UN/UK lists, no ownership or 50% rule analysis; a non-match is not legal clearance. Refused before payment if current data is unavailable. Call before sending funds to an address.
